chunks: From him, from Musa ibn al-Hasan, from Ali ibn Sulayman, from one of the Wasitis, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him)
That he complained to him of moisture (acidity), so he ordered him to eat the thyme upon the empty stomach.

key_terms.رُطُوبَة: Moisture or acidity in the stomach

ai.seo_question: What is the medicinal remedy for stomach acidity or moisture according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) prescribes consuming thyme (*sa'tar*) on an empty stomach to treat gastric moisture or acidity, reflecting the Shia tradition of integrating practical medicine with spiritual guidance. This remedy highlights the Prophetic emphasis on natural remedies and the importance of timing in treatment, aligning with the broader Islamic medical tradition that views the body as an amanah (trust) to be cared for through both divine wisdom and empirical observation.
